scope: Design-only draw and growth model; no new school, catalyst or draw rule is implemented in runtime.
starter_comparison: Same primary-school level1 starter in every arm. Actual no-catalyst random starting choice and spell-role utility are not modeled.
adaptive_formula: q + (1-q)*strength, q=currently legal primary IDs/currently legal total IDs; recomputed after every card is removed

policy_contract.primary_first: Choose a primary-school card if offered, otherwise any card; uniform tie break. A stated preference, not a measured ordinary-player behavior model.
policy_contract.learn_first: Prefer any newly learnable spell, then primary school, then uniform tie break.
policy_contract.upgrade_first: Prefer an owned spell, then primary school, then higher current level, then uniform tie break.
policy_contract.mixed_four_four: Try to learn four primary and four other spells: prefer new spells below the relevant four-slot target, larger deficit first; otherwise upgrade owned spells before exceeding the target. Every offer must still select one legal card; no skips or rerolls.

omissions: combat, damage, cooldown, summon attack intervals, encounters, player skill, final60/Boss session time
spell utility differences, tags, synergy eligibility and new-school artifact catalogs
catalyst prices, income, unlock time, payback; current45 route has no meta settlement
UI starting choice and save migration; synthetic school IDs are never runtime assets
